decisions.reason: A large bulk container close to the core range, with its own page, fits established routines and uses existing manufacturing, so a large firm with slack has little cause to drop it after one year without clear evidence of a shortfall.
The valve complements the bulk-container line and has a dedicated page, so it supports core sales at low cost and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The take-back service matches the firm's strategic move toward circular, service-based offers, and its results are still uncertain, but its low visibility (only mentioned) makes it more exposed than A and B, though slack lets the firm carry it for now.
